about_the_game:
💍 Are you ready to become the boss of a wedding venue?

Start from a humble, rundown hall in a poor neighborhood and rise to host the most glamorous wedding and henna nights in town! Greet your guests, choose the music, manage food service, collect gold – and break up the occasional fight!

This isn’t just a simulator – it’s a full entrepreneurship journey.

🎤 From managing the DJ booth to calming nervous brides, from negotiating with clients to catching mischievous kids trying to steal gold – you’re in charge of everything.

🛠️ Customize your venue, organize tables, design dance floor routines, and make every night unforgettable.

📈 Grow your business, upgrade your hall, and become the king of the wedding industry!

Sometimes you're a planner, sometimes a counselor – but always the heart of the business.
Wedding Hall Simulator will charm you with its humor, chaos, and surprising realism!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5120 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. Gamepad supported.

short_description: Start from a poor wedding venue and rise to become the top wedding organizer in town! Greet clients, host henna nights and wedding events, manage food and music, collect gold, upgrade your hall. Wedding Hall Simulator lets you run the business your way!
